lines.text: Move the hour hand one hour, then two, then three, up to twenty!
lines.caption: Move the hour hand one hour, then two, then three, up to twenty!

lines.text: The hand starts at three. Tom moves it one hour, then two, then three, up to twenty.
lines.caption: The hand starts at three. Tom moves it one hour, then two, then three, up to twenty.

lines.text: Where does it point at the end?
lines.caption: Where does it point at the end?

lines.text: First, add all the moves. One plus two, all the way to twenty, is two hundred ten hours.
lines.caption: First, add all the moves. One plus two, all the way to twenty, is two hundred ten hours.

lines.text: Twelve hours is a full turn. Two hundred ten is seventeen turns, plus six.
lines.caption: Twelve hours is a full turn. Two hundred ten is seventeen turns, plus six.

lines.text: So only the six leftover hours matter!
lines.caption: So only the six leftover hours matter!

lines.text: Count six hours from three. The hand points to nine!
lines.caption: Count six hours from three. The hand points to nine!

lines.text: Not six! That's only the leftover.
lines.caption: Not six! That's only the leftover.

lines.text: Want to skip the big sum? The full lesson has a second way, and every trap.
lines.caption: Want to skip the big sum? The full lesson has a second way, and every trap.
